54e84f877ecf6fe1002d484bdf32634d394bc293.summary: ReliaQuest reports on Scattered Spider, an English-speaking collective it says works as an affiliate of the RansomHub ransomware group. In an October 2024 manufacturing-sector intrusion, the attacker social-engineered the help desk twice, reached ESXi through a privileged account, created a VM to avoid endpoint detection, and encrypted systems within six hours. The report also covers RansomHub's rise, its 90/10 affiliate profit split, English-speaking callers used by ransomware affiliates, and defensive recommendations.

54fb362a0c807a40c4d0a0bc35bde59ed84f0f98.summary: RSA Research white paper on the Carbanak/FIN7 syndicate, a criminal group attributed to intrusions in banking, hospitality, retail and other industrial sectors. It describes the Anunak/Sekur and Carberp Trojans, common crimeware, post-exploitation tools, and a 2015 slowdown followed by a 2016 resurgence. RSA says the group is persistent but not advanced, and recommends better visibility, network segmentation, and assuming breach.

A detection parser has high confidence but may false alarm on sessions with the same handshake pattern.
The report says the 2015 slowdown may reflect arrests or reorganisation; each option is described as a possible truth.

RSA has not located additional samples like the Go Trojan, so variants cannot be compared.
The Go Trojan's functionality remains unknown because the file it queries is not created by the malware.
